Subject: Office move to 4th floor — April 14

Hi everyone —

We’re moving to the 4th floor on the 14th. Please pack your desk items by the 13th; IT will move monitors for you. Thanks for your flexibility — let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
[Your Name]

Note: I tightened the wording and replaced the apology with a thank-you to sound warmer.
